supporting_observations.claim: The supplied records do not show the reported dump being created or identify its path, creator process, or contents.
Before the telemetry outage, cole.price ran WMIC to query running services from a command prompt on WS-CPRICE-01.
Around 13:23 UTC, WS-CPRICE-01 established an SMB session to DC-RB-01, with the domain computer account shown authenticating over the connection.
At 13:44 UTC, records show LSASS-related LDAP traffic from WS-CPRICE-01 to DC-RB-01, but do not establish that it was related to the reported dump.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor-coverage metadata reports that winsec and Sysmon collection on WS-CPRICE-01 was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:15 UTC because of a log collection outage; that interval includes the reported dump time. The metadata provides no record_id.
Proxy, Zeek connection, and Zeek DNS coverage is reported as available, but those records do not identify the local process that created a file.
claims_not_established: Whether a dump was actually written, its exact location, or which process created it.
Whether the dump was collected with the approved VetChart vendor tool vcdump.exe and whether the required ticket covered the collection.
Whether the dump contained sensitive data, was accessed by an unauthorized party, or was transferred elsewhere.
Whether the WMIC and SMB activity was authorized or related to the dump alert.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain endpoint telemetry for WS-CPRICE-01 during 13:30–14:15 UTC, especially process creation, file creation, and file access events.
Collect the reported dump and its filesystem metadata, hash, path, owner, and timestamps; determine the creating process and any subsequent access or transfer.
Verify the VetChart hang ticket and establish whether it authorized a dump at the reported time; check for vcdump.exe execution and its command line.
Review endpoint protection and forensic artifacts for dump-tool execution, credential or memory access, and persistence or exfiltration activity.
Establish the purpose and authorization for the WMIC query and SMB session to DC-RB-01.
